correctness.rationale: The product action is free because the 5-torsion translation on E is free. In CH^1(E×E)_Q, the graph of translation by P equals the diagonal since its difference is d^*O_E(P-O), a 5-torsion class. Thus the rational quotient projector on E×X is identity on the elliptic motive tensored with the invariant projector on X. The latter equals the pullback/pushforward projector for the degree-five Galois cover X→P1, giving a genuine rational Chow-motive equivalence. The elliptic count is #E(F5)=5 and trace 1, yielding the stated rational zeta. Theorem C at the unique jump m gives delta=floor(4(m+1)/5)-1, b1=2 gives h1, chi(O)=0 gives h2. The distinguished fixed-point section R and X-fibration fiber D have Gram matrix U, and motive b2=2 proves saturation. Finite checker independently confirms the arithmetic base cases and does not replace the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The underlying 1985 quotient family, the known unbounded Picard defect and the 2026 Theorem C are acknowledged as prior. The additional assertion is rational Chow-motive equality over F5 for all admissible exponents, explicit fixed arithmetic zeta and exact unimodular geometric numerical lattice; these require correspondence and intersection comparisons and were not located in inspected primary text or relevant indexed records. Historical inaccessible text and generic classical transfer arguments leave a genuine publication-priority risk, not a mathematical proof of absolute novelty.

value.rationale: The family supplies infinitely many nonisomorphic smooth projective characteristic-five surfaces of Kodaira dimension one with exactly the same rational Chow motives, hence the same prime-to-five cohomology and every finite-field point count, while h1(O) and h2(O) diverge. The natural codimension-one numerical lattice is computed completely and integrally as U, not just rationally or up to an unspecified index. The precise coherent/Weil disparity is a motivated boundary example for arithmetic motives and singular Picard schemes; no broad conjecture is asserted.
